out_of_scope.instructions: Before initiating any testing or submitting a report, please ensure that the asset in question is genuinely owned or operated by NVIDIA. Descriptive phrases such as “compatible with NVIDIA GPU” do not constitute confirmation of NVIDIA’s ownership or control. When in doubt, we strongly encourage you to verify the asset's ownership through the program team to avoid unintentional testing of third-party systems.
